messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "Free slots were checked and confirmed for 2025-04-14; the booking is for 2025-04-15T13:30, never checked or confirmed.", "verifier": {"reason": "The assistant violated the policy by booking an appointment on **2025-04-15** instead of the confirmed free slot on **2025-04-14**. This violates the requirement to book only slots returned as free by `get_slots` and to ensure the date matches the user's confirmation."}}
